# RYX AI

> RYX AI (Tigrid Technologies Private Limited) builds AI agents for businesses: agents that answer every enquiry, call back every lead and take repetitive work off the team, on the website, on WhatsApp and on the phone, in English, Hindi, Malayalam, Arabic and Urdu. Its product, Ferry, is an AI sales agent for websites that builds itself from the company's own website, answers visitors, qualifies leads and books meetings. Ferry is launching soon, with early access open.
